plugins.name: quartermaster
plugins.description: Reports which plugins, MCP servers and skills actually load in each project and what they cost per session, reading all eight config surfaces that decide it. Finds services reachable more than one way, enabled extensions never invoked, and settings files Claude Code silently refuses. Changes config on three axes behind a printed diff and a confirmation.
